Name: Drawberry's Cute Festival Outfits for East Scarp
Author: drawberry138
Description:
[b][u]I do NOT consent to my work being used to train AI or used in AI generation.[/u][/b]

[size=3][b][u]This mod is compatible with SCA ES. This is NOT replacing Poltergeister’s SCA ES mod. This is an add on which provides festival for the NPCs part of the original East Scarp Cast. [/u][/b][/size]

[size=3]Oh hi![/size]

[size=3]If you’re a Seasonal Cute Characters and LemurKat fan like me - I’ve made a festival outfits mod for all of the characters in East Scarp![/size]
[size=3](ESR not included - I have a different SCC mod for ESR [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43012]here[/url]!)[/size]

[size=3]This mod REQUIRES East Scarp Seasonal Cute characters, East Scarp, Content Patcher, and SMAPI. [/size]

[size=3]I RECOMMEND you download Poltergeister's[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450] [/url][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Vanilla SCC[/url][/b] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16045]East Scarp SCC[/url] mods as well as my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43012][b]East Scarp Remastered SCC[/b][/url] mod for a unified look![/size]
﻿
[size=3]Installation:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]download the mod[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]drag it into your mods folder and unzip![/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=3]Features:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]configurable noses[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Festival outfits for all! Yay![/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Juliet’s Spirit’s Eve costume has been overridden - she now wears her old (now tweaked) SCC Jellyfish costume on the Dance of the Moonlight Jellies, and will wear either a Zombie or Fortune Teller costume to Spirit’s Eve (your choice, see the config for more!)[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]If you like playing with this mod please consider endorsing it - I’m disabled and bedridden, so any support that can get my work out there helps![/size]

[size=3]If you'd like, you can buy me a coffee [url=https://ko-fi.com/drawberry138]here[/url]! I'd really appreciate it :)[/size]

[size=3]I really hope you enjoy my work! Much love and take care, Drawberry xo[/size]
